sources.note: Main website. Describes eDerm as cloud-based dermatology EHR and practice management system built by dermatologists. Lists key features: One-Touch Charting, Smart Coder, clinical photography, pathology tracking, scheduling, billing.
About page. Company in Boca Raton, FL. Emphasizes designed by dermatologists. No information on company size, employee count, or customer count.
ONC certification page. Certified Oct 2019, v2.8.0. Lists NLM API and Updox as additional integrated software. Links to FHIR/API documentation and Real World Testing plans.

EHR features page. Describes Smart Learning, Smart Coding, One-Touch Charting, physical exam, photos, patient chart, scanning, dermatology knowledge base, patient education, pathology life cycle, dashboard.

Practice management page. Covers registration, insurance verification, scheduling (multi-provider/multi-location), clinical reports, billing integration, document scanning, pathology logging, cancer patient tracking, phone messages.
RCM page. Covers insurance verification, automatic encounter coding, claims submission, payment posting, collections, financial reporting. Claims 98% first-pass rate.

FAQ page. Key details: PM/RCM run in browser on Windows, EHR is native iPad app. Lab interfaces for multiple labs. Patient portal provides access to medical records only (no self-registration or payment). MU Stage 1 certified, working on Stage 2. Electronic filing for primary/secondary/tertiary claims.

Third-party profile. Zero reviews/ratings. Custom pricing. Lists features: One-Touch Charting, Smart Coder, photo management. Mentions Surescripts integration. Target: dermatology clinics, cosmetic derm, Mohs surgery, dermatopathology labs.

Third-party EHR profile. Lists features: appointment management, billing, clinical workflow, document management, EM coding, insurance/claims, demographics, patient portal, scheduling. Practice size 1-50 physicians. Cloud-based, ICD-10 certified.
iPad app listing. 4.5 stars, 8 ratings. v2.7.9936, last updated Jan 6 2026 with billing updates. 155.6 MB. Requires iPadOS 18.0+. Free download (requires subscription).

Updox patient portal product page. Updox provides HIPAA-compliant patient portal, secure messaging, telehealth, electronic fax, and text messaging. eDerm lists Updox as integrated additional software on its ONC certification page.
